sources.title: Tools and resources for calculating nutrient neutrality
sources.verified_claim: Natural England provides guidance and calculators for nutrient budgets in 27 specified catchments; catchment membership and scheme inputs must be established before applying a nutrient constraint.

sources.title: Using the nutrient neutrality calculators
sources.verified_claim: Current guidance defines nutrient neutrality for relevant residential development and requires catchment-specific nutrient budget calculations; March 2026 updates changed some catchment boundaries and treatment assumptions.

sources.title: Natural England’s nutrient mitigation scheme for developers
sources.verified_claim: Natural England's current scheme provides nutrient credits in specified catchments; credit availability is a mitigation mechanism, not evidence that an arbitrary parcel lies in an affected catchment.

sources.title: Tees catchment: nutrient mitigation credits
sources.verified_claim: Tees guidance requires affected development to calculate nutrient mitigation need and submit calculations through the LPA; it is catchment-specific and cannot be transferred to London sample parcels.

sources.title: Poole Harbour catchment: nutrient mitigation credits
sources.verified_claim: Poole Harbour guidance links nutrient credit need to development inside the protected-site catchment and planning permission process; no sample candidate is treated as affected without spatial proof.

sources.title: Terms and conditions: nutrient mitigation scheme
sources.verified_claim: Current scheme terms define the legal/administrative framework for Natural England nutrient credits; contractual availability does not prove candidate catchment status or nutrient budget.

sources.title: Appropriate assessment
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Habitats Regulations Assessment requires screening and, where significant effects cannot be excluded, appropriate assessment before authorisation; this is a project/site-specific gate.

sources.title: Nutrient Mitigation Scheme – clarification of Natural England’s role
sources.verified_claim: Natural England explains that nutrient credits support planning in affected areas and that LPAs retain planning decisions; this explanatory source is not candidate-level evidence.
